posts.author: K-apple
posts.body:
If this is in the wrong thread then please direct me to the right one because I need help this. I am currently using the Visustella Frontview Battle UI for my Frontview battles but I keep having issues.
Normally when using certain parameters, the image from the <Battle Portrait: filename> stays and only fades when selecting a command. And when using certain tags like "Certain Hit" does it swap to another image. Thats what I want to happen.
But when using full names instead the image automatically swaps images when I just hover over the inputs and not directly selecting them. When I go to turn off the parameter that shows during input, it turns off all images. And in some cases the images start to overlap with each other.
These are my personal settings.
Can anyone tell me what I'm doing wrong.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I assume it's intended that the image changes just when "hovering" over the command when you set the input phase pics, but if your plugins are updated to latest versions and you keep getting pictures on top of each other, send a bug report to VisuStella.
